 Summary
 Fernandes left on bench by Man Utd v Bournemouth as Maguire takes captaincy

 Jess Anderson and Charlotte Coates
 Show Most recent Most popular Post published at 14:35 GMT 14:35 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Newcastle are having the better of it possession-wise but they're yet to have a shot on target. 
 Striker William Osula has only had four touches of the ball so far. 
 3 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Man Utd 'playing with no confidence' published at 14:33 GMT 14:33 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 The negative crowd reaction won't help the players because you can see this group of players are playing with no confidence at the moment and no one really wants the ball or to try and make things happen.
 292 100 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:33 GMT 14:33 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Florian Wirtz sends a corner into Alexis Mac Allister at the near post but he gets far too much on his header and sends the ball into the Anfield Road end. 
 113 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:33 GMT 14:33 GMT 
 Hull 1-0 Brentford 
 Image source, Getty Images Hull are unbeaten across their last 14 home Premier League games in which they've netted the opening goal (W9 D5).
 Since joining Hull in 2025, Oli McBurnie has scored all four of his penalties in league action.
 89 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Brighton need to relax' published at 14:32 GMT 14:32 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Charlie Adam 
Former Liverpool midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live extra 
 Brighton are all over the place and a bit erratic in terms of defence. They just need to relax because the next goal is massive. 
 They need to get back to what they are good at. 
 179 177 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:32 GMT 14:32 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Nice work from Youri Tielemans and he sends the ball into the box but James Hill is there to make the block and his goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic tidies up.
 87 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:31 GMT 14:31 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Neil Johnston 
BBC Sport football reporter at Selhurst Park 
 Not a great game this. The wind is a big factor.
 Newcastle are struggling to offer much attacking threat. Nothing on target so far.
 Palace are seeking a first Premier League clean sheet at Selhurst Park since April.
 After all the goals they have leaked recently, it's a case of so far so good.
 59 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 14:31 GMT 14:31 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 This is what Fernandes was alluding to. It looks like the tactics are not to press and let the opposition play out. With so much time, one or two decent passes and they’re in behind us. Very poor from the coaching team.
 David 
 Really poor start by United. So dull and pedestrian. Considering Carrick's future is hanging by a thread, i wouldn't say these players are lung busting to try and make a point and get a result.
 James 
 284 79 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:31 GMT 14:31 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Image source, Getty Images Not many chances to shout about in this one as Dan Burn launches himself at the deep ball into the box but it was way too much to ask. 
 52 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:30 GMT 14:30 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Opta now says that Florian Wirtz's goal has been given to Brighton's Pascal Gross. It did take a hefty deflection off him. 
 165 593 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:29 GMT 14:29 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 That is a heck of a delivery from Rayan into the box and Evanilson throws himself at it but the ball just skims his head and he can't get any purchase or direction on it.
 87 61 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Ruthless Liverpool published at 14:29 GMT 14:29 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 The clocks have changed and it's the first time that Liverpool have scored in the first half at Anfield in the Premier League this season.
 Better late than never. Liverpool have punished Brighton ruthlessly.
 678 112 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:29 GMT 14:29 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Incredible stuff from Ronald Araujo as he manages to head the ball clear while lying on the turf. 
 Brighton looked pretty likely to halve the deficit but some desperate Liverpool defending cleared the danger. 
 476 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 14:28 GMT 14:28 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Tyler Adams goes into the book for a foul in the middle of the park.
 103 63 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:28 GMT 14:28 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 I'm sure Michael Carrick would have loved to get through today without having to turn to Bruno Fernandes. A comfortable win without the Portuguese would have suited him just fine.
 But in reality, that seems unlikely.
 260 114 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:27 GMT 14:27 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Image source, Getty Images Bruno Fernandes is still Manchester United's best player so if you're not winning football matches and you look to the bench and you've got Fernandes there, then you have to bring him on. 
 211 515 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 14:26 GMT 14:26 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Really, really didn't expect a start like this from Liverpool...
 Aarav 
 All 100m+ men involved!
 Andrew 
 That second Liverpool goal was classic Klopp style, and is what we missed so much. Counter press, fast break.
 Jason 
 899 172 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:26 GMT 14:26 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Image source, Getty Images Harvey Barnes is looking lively but he opts to go for the early strike instead of going past Anan Khalaili and his effort is blocked. 
 61 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:25 GMT 14:25 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Alexander Isak has scored in three consecutive Premier League appearances for the first time since January 2025 for Newcastle (run of eight).
 652 133 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:25 GMT 14:25 GMT 
 Liverpool 2-0 Brighton 
 Brighton are struggling to deal with Liverpool here. It certainly isn't the Liverpool we've seen at Anfield in recent times.
